### 1 — Scene
A breakfast tray with two fried eggs, two pieces of raisin toast or French toast, a small pat of butter, two orange-marmalade packets, strawberry yogurt, and a milky hot drink.

### 2 — Vessel
The main plate appears approximately **23 cm in diameter**.
Area = 3.14 × 11.5² ≈ **415 cm²**. The mug and packaged accompaniments are estimated separately.

### 3–7 — Items, area, volume, weight, and energy
The browned bread appears moist and dense, so I estimate it as **raisin French toast**, though plain raisin toast is possible. Calories include cooking fat within the cooked toast and egg estimates; no separate pool of oil is visible.

| Item | Plate area covered | Gross volume calculation | Density | Estimated grams | kcal/100 g | Estimated kcal |
|---|---:|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| Raisin French toast, two pieces | 34% | 141 cm² × 0.85 cm = 120 ml | 0.9 | 108 | 290 | 313 |
| Two fried eggs | 30% | 125 cm² × 0.85 cm = 106 ml | 1.0 | 106 | 195 | 207 |
| Butter, small pale pat at right | 2% | 8 cm² × 0.6 cm = 5 ml | 0.95 | 5 | 717 | 36 |
| Orange marmalade, two packets | Off plate | Approximately 28 ml combined | 1.0 | 28 | 250 | 70 |
| Strawberry yogurt | Off plate | Approximately 100 ml in the small tub | 1.03 | 103 | 100 | 103 |
| Milky tea or coffee | Off plate | Approximately 230 ml visible in mug | 1.0 | 230 | 15 | 35 |

**Area check:** 34% + 30% + 2% = **66% of the plate covered**, consistent with the visible bare plate. Packaged-food contents are estimated from their containers; packaging is excluded. No unseen sugar is assumed in the drink.

### 8 — Sanity check
The plate itself contains approximately **219 g and 556 kcal**, plausible for two eggs, two modest pieces of enriched toast, and butter. Including the drink and accompaniments gives approximately **580 g and 764 kcal**. The largest uncertainty is whether the bread is French toast or plain raisin toast.
